# App Updates

All updates and new files for the Octofit Tracker backend must be placed in the `octofit-tracker/backend/octofit_tracker` directory unless otherwise specified.

- Ensure all Django models, management commands, and related backend files are created or updated in this directory.
- Follow the project structure and conventions as outlined in the repository instructions.
- Use the Python virtual environment in `octofit-tracker/backend/venv` for all backend operations.
- When updating or creating files, do not change directories in terminal commands; always use full or relative paths as required.
